commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Sport D300 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Sport D300 (AJ300D) delivers strong efficiency and torque, but like other modern Ingenium diesels, it is susceptible to specific emissions and cooling system wear points. Rebuilt engines sourced through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: DPF Regeneration & EGR Carbon Buildup - Why the Range Rover Sport D300 AJ300D Loses Efficiency
problems.rootCause: Frequent short-trip urban driving prevents complete passive DPF regenerations, leading to soot accumulation and EGR valve clogging, which restricts airflow and triggers warning lights.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Forced DPF regeneration and EGR valve cleaning.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early with no severe back-pressure damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if severe blockage causes back-pressure damage or hydrolock.

problems.recommendation: For early signs of DPF restriction or AdBlue faults, targeted specialist repair is highly cost-effective. However, if the AJ300D has suffered catastrophic overheating, severe internal wear, or repeated emissions system failures, a full rebuilt engine with upgraded internals offers the best long-term reliability and protects your significant vehicle investment.

problems.h4: SCR/AdBlue System Faults - Why the Range Rover Sport D300 AJ300D Triggers Emissions Warnings
problems.rootCause: NOx sensor failures or AdBlue heater malfunctions are common in colder climates or with inconsistent fluid quality, triggering limp mode and preventing engine restarts once the countdown expires.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing faulty NOx sensors or AdBlue heaters.
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended first step for warning lights without mechanical engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Required if AdBlue crystallization has caused severe intake or injector damage.
